profile.name: 串口数据接口组件
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于实验控制中的串口数据通道访问。它提供查询串口缓冲区可读字节数和按字节读取数据的能力，适合在基于 SCPI 的仪器通信流程中处理底层数据收发。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software communication component for accessing a serial data channel in laboratory control workflows. It provides functions to query available bytes in the serial buffer and read raw bytes, making it suitable for low-level data transfer in SCPI-based instrument communication.
